post.description: Exchanges email and password for a short-lived access token (JWT, 15 minutes, sent later as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`) and a refresh token used to obtain new pairs through `PUT /token-renew`. Accounts that registered through `POST /signup` must be activated first.

403.description: The account is not active yet

put.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token **and a new refresh token**. Refresh tokens are single-use (rotated): the one sent is revoked, and re-using a revoked token revokes every active token of the user. No `Authorization` header is needed. Clients should share a single in-flight renewal between concurrent requests.

401.description: Invalid, revoked or expired refresh token

delete.description: Revokes the given refresh token. Idempotent; unknown or already revoked tokens also return 200.
